scenes.setting: The ambush inverts: Tyre carries the Scarlet Lunar Corona (Steve predicted the plan), Sharron collapses weakened but opens her Door of Mysteries on frenzied Jason; sedated Maric holds on — and Klein's All-Black Eye finds the invisible Steve about to possess Maric: decoy explosion, then a Cleave-charged purifying bullet fires
scenes.text_anchor: Wraith Steve! He wants to possess Maric!
